name: Douro Historic Train Season Opening
description: The charming steam-powered historic train resumes its stunning trips along the Douro River this Saturday, offering unparalleled views of the terraced vineyards and breathtaking landscapes.
longDescription:
The Douro Historic Train Season Opening marks the return of the steam-powered train service for its annual journey through the Douro Valley. Operated by Comboios de Portugal (CP), the national railway company, this event signifies the start of the regular tourist season for this specific heritage route. The initiative aims to preserve and showcase the historic railway line and its connection to the region's viticulture and natural beauty.

Visitors will embark on a journey from Régua to Tua, traveling alongside the Douro River. The route offers views of the terraced vineyards and the river landscape from the perspective of a vintage train. The journey provides a relaxed pace for observing the scenery. The experience is suitable for individuals and groups interested in historical transport and regional landscapes.

The event takes place on 2026-06-06. Ticketing information and availability are typically managed through CP's official channels. The starting point, Régua, is accessible by regional train services from Porto. Further details regarding accessibility for passengers with mobility needs are usually available on the operator's website.
